summary:
I added section "9 Second research wave" to the end of /Users/nubs/thenetwork/docs/research/2026-11-07-state-machines.md. Sections 1 to 8 are unchanged: the old text is a byte-for-byte prefix of the new file. I also copied the 42 agent reports (30 audit-*.md and 12 sweep-*.md) to /Users/nubs/thenetwork/docs/research/state-machines/wave3/. I ran no git command that changes state. Nothing is committed.

Section 9 has these parts:
- 9.1 Method. There were 30 model audits and 12 area sweeps, and two skeptics checked each suspected defect (348 votes). The work ran twice because a usage limit stopped the first run. Run 1 had 17 audits and 8 sweeps and made W3-001 to W3-436. Run 2 had 13 audits and 4 sweeps and made W3-437 to W3-677. The section also lists the limits.
- 9.2 A catalog of the 38 new machines: states and transitions, file:line, rules and the wave 4 module.
- 9.3 The model gaps and model errors, listed per model.
- 9.4 The 108 open carve-outs, each with whether it can be fixed now.
- 9.5 The defect register with all 174 rows. Refuted rows stay and are marked.
- 9.6 The wave 4 plan: rules, a module table with scopes, and the blocked list.

Numbers: 677 items, of which 622 are live. 37 live items are blocked because they need a founder or maintainer decision, an upstream contract change or a copy change. The other 585 are in 41 modules: 30 extend an existing model and 11 are new (cloud_auth, mcp_authorize, peon_postings, migrations, shared_actions, network_tick, outreach_budget, participation, row_locks, rate_window, fraud_review). Each live item is in exactly one module or in the blocked list. The largest module has 25 items.

Caveats:
- Most audits read the branch before claude/formal-main was merged in. Items such as W3-131, W3-100, W3-037, W3-326 and W3-348 may already be closed by that merge.
- A script took the verdict reasons from the first 500 characters of each vote, so some reasons stop mid-sentence.
- Duplicate pairs are in the same module, for example W3-021 with W3-645, and W3-141 with W3-650.

The generator and the plan are in the session scratchpad: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-nubs-thenetwork/23176afd-5b3d-4d8c-a4f0-93e91db255eb/scratchpad/w4/gen.py, assign.py, scopes.py and plan.json.
